competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase its chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Increases the damage by 50% if all of your skills are on cooldown.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

effets.note: If all of your skills are on cooldown

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to deal damage that ignores Defense. Increases your Attack Bar by 50% when attacked by an enemy while [Azure Dragon Sever] is on cooldown.

effets.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: When attacked by an enemy while this skill is on cooldown

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to absorb their Attack Bar by 50% and disturb HP recovery for 2 turns. Your attacks won't land as a Glancing Hit while [Fire Dragon Blaze] is on cooldown.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
The target's HP cannot be recovered.
This attack won't land as a glancing hit
effets.note: While [Fire Dragon Blaze] is on cooldown
